Society goes off the rails

October 12, 2026

Julie Smyth, World, October 12, 2026

Share

The internet ripped apart again recently over the “Cornell Seven,” a group of fraternity brothers formerly of the Chi Phi house at Cornell University now accused of sexually assaulting a young woman in October 2024. Jane Doe filed a civil lawsuit alleging Cornell and others failed to properly investigate or penalize those involved. 

I’ll spare you the lurid details but suffice to say the story involved drugs and group sex, a debate over consent, late reporting, and morally depraved texts among the men in question.
